observation: The package-owned agent-loop-discipline SKILL.md combines lifecycle authority, agent I/O, prompt controls, navigation, L2 contract construction, engineering routing, role routing, evidence/output, hook boundaries, and validation/close in one always-loaded entry point.

evidence.summary: Direct source inspection of resources/skills/agent-loop-discipline/SKILL.md at the approved Contract base commit, plus the user-supplied comparison against skill-scope, context-and-disclosure, and reference-routing practices. Runtime selection/use remains unobserved.

hypothesis: The entry point may load unrelated conditional guidance for ordinary governed tasks; a bounded progressive-disclosure split into directly routed references may preserve authority while reducing irrelevant context.
validated_conclusion: The current entry point has ten distinct sections with different conditional triggers. The source confirms a bounded progressive-disclosure refactor is a plausible UPDATE_SKILL candidate, but no runtime token or skill-selection effect is yet proven.

validation_case.given: An existing package-owned workflow skill combines universally required authority with branch-specific routing and validation detail.
validation_case.when: Review the entry point against actual invocation triggers and preserve only the rules required for every invocation.
validation_case.then: Keep universal authority in SKILL.md and route conditional detail through directly discoverable references without changing lifecycle ownership.
